preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices in each test case is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges) for n, edges in zip(ns, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip(ns, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: Each test case forms a tree with n-1 edges.

postconditions.description: The number of outputs matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(k, int) and k >= 0 for k in output)
postconditions.description: Each output is a nonnegative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(k == min_queries(n, edges) for k, (n, edges) in zip(output, zip(ns, edge_lists)))
postconditions.description: Each output is the minimum number of queries needed to uniquely identify the hidden vertex x.
